name: moodboard
description: Pull visual inspiration from a local Pinterest mirror into a design brief. Queries a qmd-indexed pin shadow, surfaces 3 curated candidates with thumbnail previews, lets you pick/reject/refine, then extracts design DNA (palette, type, texture, composition, motion) and writes MOODBOARD.md as input for design-consultation, frontend-design, or design-shotgun. Local-only — depends on ~/wiki/pinterest/ and the qmd MCP.
